findings.title: Album type-mixing predicate (Decision 5) not enforceable at this layer
findings.detail: Decision 5 requires rejecting audio/document mixed with photo/video in one album group. The Task 1 model (MediaItem = {mediaUrl, caption}) carries NO per-item media-kind discriminator, so the predicate cannot be evaluated at save time. validateAlbum enforces the enforceable subset (2..10 items, valid media source per item, caption-on-first-only). Documented as a deviation in decisions.md; the type-mix test from the task list is therefore not added (it cannot be exercised against the current model).
findings.action: documented; no code change (model limitation, out of this task's file scope)
